name: Peraleda del Zaucejo (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peraleda del Zaucejo (trees and flowers on white).
history: Municipal flag of Peraleda del Zaucejo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
